reviews.title: Modern Old School
reviews.comment: I'm using this case for a linux server with multiple enterprise drives for network storage and container hosting.  The tower looks dressed for the role compared to a mesh or glass gaming tower.  It's built to reduce noise while still allowing for great airflow.  Top and side panels are customizable for additional fans/airflow.
reviews.author: DSTN

reviews.title: Perfect for non rack server
reviews.comment: Needed a case that supported several 3.5” drives but wasnt a full rack size factor. Also wanted enough space to support a CPU and GPU as well. This case does it perfectly. Able to fit air cooler and GPU and has plenty of space for all my hard drives. Would recommend
reviews.author: AGonzalez
